बॉस, बॉक्स ऑफिस पर छाई है रणबीर कपूर और यश की बड़ी फिल्म!

रणबीर कपूर और यश स्टारर फिल्म Ramayana Part One ने शनिवार को बॉक्स ऑफिस पर शानदार बढ़त दिखाई है।
रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, फिल्म ने शुरुआती दो दिनों में यानी शुक्रवार तक 110 करोड़ रुपये का नेट कलेक्शन कर लिया है।
विदेशों यानी overseas में भी फिल्म का जादू चल रहा है और इसने सिर्फ 2 दिनों में 10 मिलियन अमेरिकी डॉलर का आंकड़ा पार कर लिया है।
फिल्म का कुल worldwide कलेक्शन 229 करोड़ रुपये तक पहुंच गया है, हालांकि साउथ में अभी भी कैपेसिटी से जुड़ी कुछ दिक्कतें देखने को मिल रही हैं।

क्या आपने अभी तक यह माइथोलॉजिकल एपिक फिल्म देखी या नहीं? 🍿

ctx.title: Ramayana Part One Early Box Office Trends: Ranbir Kapoor and Yash starrer grows on Saturday, Capacity issues in South, Outstanding overseas
ctx.summary:
Ramayana: Part One is looking to collect Rs. 68 crore nett approx on Saturday in India, with the Hindi version on track to Rs. 50 crore nett and the South-dubbed versions bringing in Rs. 18 crore nett. That will put its three-day collection just under Rs. 180 crore nett. 
 There is a growth in business today of around 45-50 per cent, roughly the same for Hindi and South versions. In the morning, it seemed to be even better, but the Diwali festivities slowed down business in Hindi, and the film was facing capacity issues in South India, particularly in Tamil Nadu, Kerala and Bengaluru, where demand far exceeded available shows. A metro centre like Chennai had virtually no tickets available starting from the evening, for both the Hindi and Tamil versions. There is a strong spillover in all these centres, with advances for tomorrow filling up. The wait is to see these scenes repeat in the Hindi centres on Monday.  
 The film is also having an outstanding day overseas. In the United Kingdom, the film is on course to shatter the all-time single-day record for an Indian film. It should go over GBP 700K, possibly even GBP 800K, with collections running more than double that of Friday. The film is also seeing the UAE put up good collections today after underperforming on the first two days. Finally, the presales in North America are super strong. In all, it should be a USD 6.50 million plus day, potentially reaching USD 7 million. 
 NOTE : The above numbers are inclusive of 3D charge
